name: flip_cols
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='live_flip_log' order by ordinal_position

name: snap_cols
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='live_snapshot' order by ordinal_position

name: flip_recent
sql: select count(*) n, min(first_live_seen_at) mn, max(first_live_seen_at) mx, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by gap_seconds) med_gap, count(*) filter (where gap_seconds > 300) wide from public.live_flip_log where first_live_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days'

name: flip_rows
sql: select * from public.live_flip_log where first_live_seen_at >= now() - interval '48 hours' order by first_live_seen_at

name: snap_now
sql: select id, updated_at, jsonb_typeof(payload) t, case when jsonb_typeof(payload)='array' then jsonb_array_length(payload) end n from public.live_snapshot

name: alerts287
sql: select a.id, a.eval_at, a.player_a, a.player_b, a.side_player, a.event_id, ev.start_at, ev.home, ev.away from ten287_bot.alerts a left join ten287_rec.events ev on ev.event_id=a.event_id where a.mode='live' and a.eval_at >= now() - interval '48 hours' order by a.eval_at

name: alerts280
sql: select a.id, a.eval_at, a.player_a, a.player_b, a.side_player, a.fixture_id, fx.scheduled_start from ten280_bot.alerts a left join public.kibl_fixtures fx on fx.fixture_id=a.fixture_id where a.mode='live' and a.eval_at >= now() - interval '48 hours' order by a.eval_at
